content.text:
Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status at the **preferred** level with four minimal operations:

1. **§ 14.2.6 (p0765)** — single-sentence operator change: "SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate" → "SFJ may not terminate", removing the change-of-control exit without deleting the payment sentence (avoiding the dangling cross-references in § 14.2.6 and p0766, which is now left byte-for-byte unchanged).
2. **§ 15.6 (p0814)** — insert "which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld" into the consent lead-in.
3. **§ 15.6 (p0814)** — "either Party" → "PB", so the consent-free Affiliate/successor right runs only to PB and SFJ needs consent.
4. **Insert after p0818** — one concise sentence barring SFJ assignment to a PB competitor (the p0817 restriction lapses at Program Transfer).

All prior offending extras were removed, and the official minimality gate and precision checks returned ok:true.
